(pedda)gopālācārya
of Śāntalūri family; great-grandfather of Kṛṣṇasūri (a. of Alam3kāramīmām3sā etc.); went to Navadvīpa for disputations in Nyāya.
See V. Raghavan, p. 4, Intro. to his edn. of Amaramaṇḍana of Kṛṣṇasūri, DCRI. Poona, 1949.

(Peñjala)jhiṅgayya
son of Peñjalla Mañcanācārya.
--Prayogapaddhati. Āpast. BP. p.. 54. 299. 356.

(Pedda)tirumala
(15th Cent.) son of Aṇṇamācārya.
--Udāharaṇanītiśataka.
--Cakravālamañjarī.
--Bhagavadgītā.
--Repharakāranirṇaya.
--Śṛṅgāradaṇḍaka. [Page182-a.
--Śṛṅgāraśataka.
--Sudarśanaragaḍa.
See Inscription of Tāllapāka Tiruveṅgalanātha, J. of Śrī. Veṅk. Ori. Inst. I. i. p. 101.
